tool.name: foscat-synthesis
tool.description: Multi-scale scattering-transform synthesis (and gap-filling) of HEALPix maps and 2D images via FOSCAT

param.name: target_map
param.label: Target reference map (.npy). HEALPix: 1D (n_pixels,) or (1, n_pixels). 2D image: (H, W) or (1, H, W).

param.name: starting_map
param.label: Optional starting map (.npy, same shape as target). Leave unset to generate random noise scaled to the target's mean/std.

param.name: eval_mask
param.label: Optional evaluation mask (.npy, same shape as target). Restricts where the scattering statistics are computed (e.g. ocean-only). Leave unset to use all pixels.

param.name: update_mask
param.label: Optional update mask (.npy, same shape as target). Restricts which pixels the synthesis updates (e.g. cloudy regions only — for gap-filling). Leave unset to update all pixels.

param.name: norient
param.label: Number of orientations for the scattering transform (FOSCAT NORIENT)

param.name: kernelsz
param.label: Kernel size for the scattering transform (FOSCAT KERNELSZ)

param.name: seed
param.label: Random seed for the starting noise (used only when starting_map is empty)

param.name: do_lbfgs
param.label: Use L-BFGS optimizer (default). Uncheck to use FOSCAT's first-order fallback.

param.name: eval_frequency
param.label: Validation print frequency in iterations (0 = nsteps/10, the FOSCAT default)

tool.help:
foscat-synthesis ================
Synthesize a map (or fill gaps in a map) so that its multi-scale scattering-transform statistics match a target reference, using `FOSCAT <https://github.com/jmdelouis/FOSCAT>`__ (Delouis et al. 2022). Works on both **HEALPix** (1D arrays of length ``12 * nside**2``) and **2D images** (rectangular grids, any ``(H, W)``) — controlled by the ``domain`` parameter.
The same algorithm covers two distinct use cases, controlled by which optional masks are supplied:
- **Pure synthesis** — generate a new realization with the same scattering statistics as a target map (e.g. a cosmological large-scale structure map, an astrophysical foreground, or a natural-image texture). Provide only the target; the tool starts from random noise scaled to the target's mean/std. - **Gap-filling** — replace masked regions of an observed map with values whose scattering statistics match a gap-free reference (e.g. cloudy SST pixels filled to match an L4 product, or missing image patches inpainted to match the surrounding texture). Supply the reference as ``target_map``, the gappy-observed-plus-baseline as ``starting_map``, an evaluation mask (where reference statistics are computed), and an update mask (which pixels the synthesis is allowed to modify).
Inputs ------
- **Target map** (``.npy``):
- HEALPix domain: 1D array of length ``12 * nside**2``, or 2D ``(1, n_pixels)``. - 2D-image domain: 2D ``(H, W)`` array, or 3D ``(1, H, W)``.
- **Starting map** (``.npy``, optional): same shape as target. If absent, the tool generates random Gaussian noise scaled to the target's mean and std. - **Evaluation mask** (``.npy``, optional): same shape as target. Restricts where the scattering statistics are computed (e.g. ocean-only). If absent, all pixels contribute. - **Update mask** (``.npy``, optional): same shape as target. Restricts which pixels the synthesis updates (FOSCAT's ``grd_mask``). Use this for gap-filling — only the cloudy/missing pixels are updated, observed pixels stay fixed.
Parameters ----------
- ``domain`` — ``healpix`` (default) or ``image_2d``. Selects the FOSCAT mode (``use_2D=True`` is set internally for ``image_2d``). - ``norient`` (default ``4``) — number of orientations for the scattering transform. - ``kernelsz`` (default ``3``) — kernel size. - ``nsteps`` (default ``300``) — synthesis iterations (``NUM_EPOCHS``). - ``seed`` (default ``1234``) — seed for the random starting noise.
Advanced options ----------------
A small advanced panel exposes solver knobs that experienced users may want to tune. Defaults match FOSCAT's recommended settings.
- ``do_lbfgs`` (default true) — use the L-BFGS optimizer. Uncheck to use FOSCAT's first-order fallback. - ``eval_frequency`` (default 0 → ``nsteps/10``) — how often, in iterations, the loss is printed during synthesis.
Outputs -------
- **Synthesized map** (``.npy``): same shape as the target (1D for HEALPix, 2D for images). - **Results JSON**: tool config, validation statistics (target/synth mean and std), and the scattering-coefficient error before and after synthesis with an "improvement %" summary.
Origin ------
Wraps the FOSCAT synthesis pattern shared across the FIESTA-OSCARS chains `fiesta-scattering-astro <https://github.com/annefou/fiesta-scattering-astro>`__, `fiesta-scattering-sst <https://github.com/annefou/fiesta-scattering-sst>`__, and `fiesta-scattering-sst-healpix-geo <https://github.com/annefou/fiesta-scattering-sst-healpix-geo>`__. The chain-specific parts (data ingest, preprocessing, masking choices, plot generation) live at the workflow level on WorkflowHub; this tool provides only the generic FOSCAT optimization step.
